analysis: SFMC-REQ-002 specifies that the software shall update the displayed position at least once every 500 ms in Manual Flight, Autopilot, or Combat mode. The operational modes referenced are explicitly enumerated in Section 1.3. The timing boundary (500 ms) is quantifiable and testable, and the obligation is properly allocated to the SFMC. No writing defects or safety interactions were identified.
summary: SFMC-REQ-002 is a well-defined functional performance requirement with verifiable timing bounds and clear operational modes.
